scenarios.name: malicious_powershell_chain
scenarios.description: Office-parent spawns encoded PowerShell, which contacts a local HTTP server, drops a file, sets a Run-key persistence entry, and spawns a child process.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WIN11-LAB: process powershell.exe. Review this process and its related activity.

scenarios.name: credential_access
scenarios.description: rundll32 invokes comsvcs.dll MiniDump against lsass.exe, writing a dump file — the LSASS memory access signature. No real credentials involved.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WIN11-LAB: process rundll32.exe. Review this process and its related activity.

scenarios.name: benign_powershell
scenarios.description: Interactive admin PowerShell session launched from explorer.exe. No network, no encoded command, no persistence.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WIN11-LAB: process powershell.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
